map.面积占比分级：<5% 轻度（毛细血管扩张 I 级）、5–15% 中度（II 级）: Area proportion grading: <5% mild (telangiectasia grade I), 5–15% moderate (grade II), 15–30% severe (grade III), ≥30% very severe (grade IV); the proportion is capped at 100%. Vessel diameter typing: <0.2 μm fine vessels (capillary telangiectasia), <1 μm medium vessels (venule dilatation), ≥1 μm coarse vessels (vein dilatation). Used to assess the severity of facial telangiectasia (red web) and to support treatment decisions.
